title: API Rate Limiting
content: HTTP 429 indicates too many requests. Check API rate limits, inspect recent request volume, and recommend exponential backoff with retry.

title: Login and Authentication Issues
content: When users cannot log in, check authentication service health, identity provider availability, token expiration, and authentication logs. Escalate if multiple customers are affected.

title: Database Connection Errors
content: For database connectivity failures, verify database availability, connection pool usage, network connectivity, and recent deployment changes.
